assay: bulk total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA, Ribo-Zero Gold), NextSeq 500 PE100; Salmon 0.9.1 -> tximport gene-level (S2.2.p1-p2)
sample_inclusion: 24 female rats, generation 19, 14 months: HRT and LRT lines x {3 d hindlimb cast immobilisation (HI), control (CTRL)}, n=6/group, separate control animals (S2.p1, S2.1.p2)
plantaris and soleus from each animal (immobilised limb for HI) -> 48 libraries (S2.1.p2, S2.2.p1)

factors.name: tis
factors.type: within-animal (two muscles per rat); analysed separately

primary_estimand: Within each muscle (plantaris, soleus): transcriptome response to 3 d hindlimb immobilisation (disuse atrophy) in each endurance-trainability line (HIinLRT, HIinHRT), and the line difference in that response (DELTA = HIinLRT - HIinHRT, a line x treatment interaction). The 8-week endurance training at ~12 weeks only phenotyped the breeding lines; all sequenced rats are 14 months old and there is no trained-vs-sedentary contrast in the sequenced samples. 'Exercise' enters as the genetic endurance-trainability line (associational).

planned_contrasts.name: PLN_HIinLRT
planned_contrasts.definition: plantaris LRT HI vs LRT CTRL

planned_contrasts.name: PLN_HIinHRT
planned_contrasts.definition: plantaris HRT HI vs HRT CTRL

planned_contrasts.name: PLN_DELTA
planned_contrasts.definition: plantaris (LRT HI - LRT CTRL) - (HRT HI - HRT CTRL)

planned_contrasts.name: SOL_HIinLRT
planned_contrasts.definition: soleus LRT HI vs LRT CTRL

planned_contrasts.name: SOL_HIinHRT
planned_contrasts.definition: soleus HRT HI vs HRT CTRL

planned_contrasts.name: SOL_DELTA
planned_contrasts.definition: soleus (LRT HI - LRT CTRL) - (HRT HI - HRT CTRL)

exploratory_contrasts: LRT vs HRT within CTRL and within HI, per muscle (associational, genotype)

blocking_or_covariance.status: one sample per animal per muscle; RIN covariate in the paper model (S2.2.p2); animal key not reported

matrix_scale: Salmon estimated counts summarised by tximport (S2.2.p2; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: limma-voom with RNA integrity (RIN) covariate; gene filter not stated (14,789 genes 'detected/expressed', S3.4.p1, S3.5.p1, FIG2)
paper_formula: not_reported; implied group means + RIN with pairwise contrasts HIinLRT, HIinHRT, DELTA

paper_threshold.adjustment: BH (limma topTable default; method not named)
paper_threshold.effect_cutoff_original: logFC > 1 (S3.5.p1, FIG2 legend); applied to |logFC| (up and down DEGs counted)
paper_threshold.conflicting_statement: S2.2.p2 says significance accepted at FDR < 0.001 (no effect cutoff)

reported_counts.DELTA: no DEG count; GSEA GO BP: 140 processes plantaris, 118 soleus (S3.6.p1)
reported_counts.atrogenes_logFC: PLN HRT Trim63 1.41, Fbxo32 1.62, Hdac4 2.14; PLN LRT Trim63 2.55, Fbxo32 2.74, Hdac4 2.89; SOL Hdac4 1.85 (HRT) / 2.21 (LRT) (S3.7.p1)

enrichment.method: GSEA ranked by t on GO BP, clusterProfiler, 10,000 permutations, size 25-500; FDR<0.05 & P<0.001
